bio.text: Erica Harriss, a Republican, has represented Illinois' 56th Senate District since 2023, according to her office biography.
The biography says she was born in Highland, is a Metro East native, spent six years on the Madison County Board, and is a small business owner who earlier worked in marketing and communications.
It says she earned her degree from Southern Illinois University Edwardsville and lives in Glen Carbon with her husband and three children.
